en: Colorized historic postcard showing an elegant villa-style building with a tower and ornate veranda, identified as Café Kaiserpark. Numerous tables and chairs are arranged outdoors along a central pathway, with trees and a forested hillside in the background. Printed captions in German appear at the bottom and along the left margin, along with a publisher's credit and number.
